story_text:
## Launch Event
## Earn Commissions
## What the Press Is Saying
## Complete Printing Creation Starts Here
When we were young, we built whatever we had — cardboard, wood, clay, and imagination. The ideas were always bigger than the tools.
Now, it’s time to bring those ideas to life.
AXILOOP MC8 combines 8 independent tool heads, near-zero waste switching, and a spacious 300×300×300 mm build volume to help creators turn every idea into something complete.
Create it big. Create it fast. Create it exactly the way you imagined.
## More Colors. Less Waste.
Why waste filament just to change colors?
AXILOOP MC8 keeps every tool head ready to print, so every color and every material is available exactly when you need it. With no-wipe alignment and near-zero waste switching, you spend less time purging and more time creating.
More filament becomes your model — not purge towers. Turn every color transition into pure creation, leaving less room for waste.
AXILOOP MC8 designed with 8 independent tool heads working in seamless harmony. Experience ultimate creative freedom as your most ambitious multi-material ideas unfold right on your desktop.
Clean tools change without unnecessary material loss. No messy purging, no redundant transit. Independent tool heads ensure direct, contamination-free swaps that keep your materials strictly focused on your print.
## Built To Keep Printing. Keep Creativity Moving.
Nothing kills momentum like waiting. The idea is ready, the model is sliced — and then the printer asks for another ten minutes of purging, heating, and standing around. MC8 never breaks that flow. From pre-heated tool heads to lightning-fast tool changes, every second is engineered, so the print keeps moving forward — not the clock.
## Precision At Every Layer
AXILOOP MC8 combines industrial-grade motion control with intelligent calibration, keeping every layer clean, every color aligned, and every print consistently accurate.
## Your Ideas Are Bigger Than Your Printer
AXILOOP MC8 gives you the freedom to print larger models, bigger prototypes, or multiple parts at once — without unnecessary splitting or assembly.
One machine. One print. No compromises. Print large models without splitting, turning your creations into seamless reality.
Why print one when you can print them all? Maximize every run, multiply your output, and let your productivity soar. Print more parts in every run and boost productivity.
## Designed Around People
Powerful is not equal to complicated. Whether it's your first print or your hundredth, MC8 strips away the busywork — the leveling rituals, the loading gymnastics, the midnight checks — so you spend more time creating and less time managing the machine.
Load or unload with a single touch. No more manually threading filament through the hotend. A single touch automatically loads or unloads – clean, fast, and completed before your coffee gets cold.
MC8 watches every print, catchingproblems before they become failures. AI monitors the job in real time and flags issues early — fewer failed prints, less wasted filament, more finished models on your shelf.
Monitor tool changes, filament flow, progress, temperature, and safety in real time. With 45 sensors providing comprehensive monitoring at every critical stage, anomalies are identified and addressed before they cause delays and filament waste.
Start your print from the office, monitor live progress from the couch, and adjust settings on the go. Your entire 3D printing studio fits right in your pocket.
Monitor your print status effortlessly. The integrated front-side progress light gives you a clear, real-time visual update at a glance. Check your printer's progress with a quick glance, and enjoy peace of mind while your masterpiece comes to life.
Smart standby optimization ensures your hardware stays quiet and energy-conscious between runs, reducing your carbon footprint and power bills.
## Two Editions. One Powerful Platform.
Whether you're creating colorful collectibles or engineering-grade functional parts, there's an AXILOOP MC8 built for your workflow — from everyday making to demanding engineering projects.

## Why AXILOOP
At AXILOOP, we believe every great idea deserves the right tools to become reality. Guided by our vision of "Precision Manufacturing, Boundless Dreams", we build professional 3D printers that make advanced creation more accessible, reliable, and enjoyable for makers around the world.
AXILOOP is the dedicated 3D printing division of Xike Industrial, a subsidiary of Zesum Technology (Stock Code: 301486). We benefit from over a decade of manufacturing experience, 300+ patents, and long-term partnerships with leading global companies including Corning, BYD, and Lens Technology. This strong industrial foundation gives AXILOOP the capability to develop, manufacture and deliver products with confidence.
To support creators worldwide, AXILOOP provides localized after-sales service in Germany, France, the UK, and the US, together with responsive online technical support for users across the globe.
AXILOOP. Print & Build Dreams.
## Product Design Process
Our market‑research revealed that the prevailing multi‑color 3D printers on the market at that time were equipped with AMS units. These machines suffered from slow printing speeds and excessive material waste, falling far short of users’ demands for both multi‑color capability and high printing efficiency. This motivated us to develop a 3D printer capable of delivering more color options alongside faster printing performance.
We develop desktop‑grade 3D printers targeting 3D‑print farms, professional designers and home users. Given this diverse user base, our core design vision was to create an appliance‑like device with a warm, approachable aesthetic, rather than merely a cold functional printing tool.
After multiple rounds of prototype tuning and repeated verification, the project is now ready and about to enter the mass‑production and fulfillment phase. We have great confidence and high expectations for this innovative product crafted with tremendous effort. We hope that through this crowdfunding campaign, this carefully‑refined innovation can move beyond the R&D stage, reach more real‑world users, deliver an enhanced user experience to all our backers, and we look forward to witnessing the official market launch of the product alongside all our early supporters.

faq.q: Machine | What are the differences between the standard MC8 and the MC8 Pro?
faq.a:
Both models share the same core platform: 8 independent toolheads, 300 × 300 × 300 mm build volume, and automatic filament feeding/retraction. 
The MC8 Pro adds a fully enclosed design with a transparent glass door, top enclosure, active chamber heating, internal air recirculation, and built-in HEPA + carbon filters. This gives the Pro a wider filament range: PET, ABS, ASA, PA, PC, and carbon/glass fiber reinforced polymers. 
The standard MC8 is open-frame and supports PLA, PETG, TPU, and PVA.

faq.q: APP| Which slicer does the MC8 use? What about firmware and the mobile app?
faq.a:
The MC8 does not come with proprietary slicer software. It officially supports OrcaSlicer as its designated slicing software, provided through a self-maintained fork. The printer runs on our independently developed system built on open-source firmware, which we plan to open-source at a later stage. 
A dedicated mobile app enables real-time monitoring through a 1080P AI camera, remote start/pause, temperature adjustment, toolhead movement control, chamber lighting, and sleep mode. The system also…

faq.q: Machine | What kind of nozzles does it use, and how easy are they to replace?
faq.a: The MC8 uses self-developed proprietary nozzles with hardened steel tips. The standard size is 0.4 mm, with 0.2 / 0.4 / 0.6 / 0.8 mm interchangeable sizes. The hotend features a quick-release mechanism, so the entire heating assembly can be replaced by removing three screws — no complex tools required.

faq.q: Machine | Can the MC8 print carbon fiber or other engineering materials?
faq.a: The MC8 Pro supports carbon fiber-reinforced and glass fiber-reinforced polymers out of the box, along with PET, ABS, ASA, PA, and PC. The standard MC8 is not designed for carbon/glass fiber filaments. New filament types are still under testing.

faq.q: Shipping | When Will I Provide My Shipping Information?​
faq.a: After the campaign ends, we will send out a survey via PledgeBox to collect your shipping details. Shipping fees will also be collected at the same time through the survey.

faq.q: Shipping | When will orders be shipped?
faq.a: We currently estimate the first units will start shipping in Q1 of next year (targeting March 2027). We plan to begin production as soon as the campaign ends so backers receive their machines as quickly as possible, and we will post regular updates on the campaign page.

faq.q: Warranty | What is the warranty for the MC8/MC8 Pro?
faq.a:
For both AXILOOP MC8 Standard and Pro 3D Printers, we offer a 1 year warranty except for the hotends, extruder gears and other consumable parts. Expert technical support is included for all inquiries throughout the warranty period.
The hotend components (nozzle, heat break/throat, silicone sock), extruder gears and PEI plate are consumable parts by nature and come with a 3-month warranty.

faq.q: After-Sales | How is after-sales support delivered?
faq.a: We provide after-sales support through a two-channel model. Our team members based in the US, Germany, France, Italy, the UK and the Netherlands are on hand to offer localized assistance to backers in their respective regions, while online support is available worldwide to all backers, wherever they are located.
Our engineering team is here to help. Reach them directly at: service@axiloop3d.com

faq.q: VIP | How do I get the VIP price, and what does it include?
faq.a:
Getting the VIP price takes two simple steps:
1. Pledge on Kickstarter — Log in with the same email address used for your VIP deposit and pledge for your chosen MC8 or MC8 Pro tier.
2. Receive your cashback — After the campaign ends, we verify your VIP status and refund the price difference directly through Kickstarter, bringing your final cost down to the locked VIP price. Your $20 deposit will be refunded to your original payment method.
